status: Explicit ordered collection model and Menu, TagGroup and calendar receivers; shared flat native publisher/admission, other callers and installed acceptance remain pending

license.format: Verbatim upstream license inside a Markdown text fence; interior bytes match sourceSHA256

adaptations: Owner-approved D6 replaces opaque JSX discovery, hidden native authoring hosts and generated logical keys with a complete explicit ordered immutable item model and stable caller keys.
Owned nodes/maps are immutable; original value, rendered content, props, renderer and caller ref identities remain in JavaScript.

Preserve lookup insertion history separately from linked navigation, item-only size, source at/childNodes exceptions, retained label/span history and numeric-zero filtering behavior. Explicit models reject duplicate or invalid stable keys.

NativeCollectionBuilder renders only materialized receivers. Branch children are explicit model entries; no registration-effect order, hidden native hierarchy or opaque React child evaluation determines membership.
Logical occurrence/revision identity is separate from native target identity. Filtered and state-cloned nodes retain the original logical identity without exposing it on public nodes.
Preparing an uncommitted or suspended candidate does not change action ownership. Committed revisions and cleanup reject obsolete queued operations.

Business operations require the shared visible-host admission adapter to validate the current owner/model, exact mounted original receiver, mount generation and native window. A logical model or binding string alone is not admission; no adapter means rejection.

Custom renderers and virtualizers retain the complete collection, layout delegate and persisted keys, and materialize nodes through renderNativeCollectionNode. Offscreen logical items are not native action targets.

Existing selection, controlled state, disabled behavior, contexts, renderer delegates and visible native accessibility semantics remain. Caller integration and native admission implementation are separate required integration work.

Menu, TagGroup and calendar register their original visible list/grid refs with useNativeCollectionOwnerRef. No additional native root host or special custom-renderer host is imposed. Native owner lifetime drives stale focus intent guards.

The existing CUICollectionRoot transport is reserved for the shared owner to replace with one flat explicit-model/original-ref publisher. Per-item CUICollectionNode and hierarchy discovery remain retired; baseline Root restoration is integration reconciliation, not a completed publisher implementation.

Materialized receiver leaves subscribe to adapter version changes so cached React elements refresh native binding props after acknowledgement/revocation without replacing model/actions or canceling unrelated pending work.
Logical focusedKey remains intent; native focus requests are not observed completion. Actual native target/window, accessibility and transfer qualification remain open.

additionalSources.scope: Horizontal PageUp/PageDown traversal with supplied actual native layout rectangles; source full collection order/disabled skipping and missing-target behavior retained.
Submenu branch filtering tests its first trigger label and retains that complete branch on a match.
